lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: I'm an investigator from the Cyber Crime Investigation Bureau. I need to ask you a few questions regarding the investigation.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Have you noticed anything unusual about Mr. Evan recently?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: No. He seemed cheerful as usual.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: What about around 7:30 PM? Did you notice anything unusual at that time?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: Yes. I saw someone coming from the alley behind Mr. Evan's house and entering his home.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Did you recognize who it was?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: It was raining heavily, so I couldn't see him clearly. Later, I saw him leave and run toward the central courtyard. He was carrying something that looked like a gun.
